# Generate Content Function 
generateContent <- function(prompt, api_key, model_endpoint = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash:generateContent") {
  headers <- c(`Content-Type` = "application/json")
  params <- list(`key` = api_key)
  payload <- list(contents = list(list(parts = list(list(text = as.character(prompt)))))) 
  body_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  
  res <- tryCatch(
    httr::POST(
      url = model_endpoint,
      httr::add_headers(.headers = headers),
      query = params,
      body = body_json,
      encode = "raw",
      timeout(30)
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  
  if (inherits(res, "error")) {
    return(list(ok=FALSE, status=NA, text=paste0("Network error: ", res$message)))
  }
  
  status <- httr::status_code(res)
  raw_text <- tryCatch(httr::content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), error=function(e) NA_character_)
  
  if (status == 200) {
    parsed <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(raw_text, simplifyVector=FALSE), error=function(e) NULL)
    generated_text <- NULL
    if (!is.null(parsed)) {
      if (!is.null(parsed$candidates) && length(parsed$candidates) > 0 &&
          !is.null(parsed$candidates[[1]]$content$parts) &&
          length(parsed$candidates[[1]]$content$parts) > 0) {
        generated_text <- parsed$candidates[[1]]$content$parts[[1]]$text
      } else if (!is.null(parsed$outputs) && length(parsed$outputs) > 0 &&
                 !is.null(parsed$outputs[[1]]$content) &&
                 !is.null(parsed$outputs[[1]]$content$parts) &&
                 length(parsed$outputs[[1]]$content$parts) > 0) {
        generated_text <- parsed$outputs[[1]]$content$parts[[1]]$text
      } else if (!is.null(parsed$results) && length(parsed$results) > 0) {
        generated_text <- paste(unlist(parsed$results), collapse="\n")
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(generated_text)) {
      return(list(ok=TRUE, status=status, text=as.character(generated_text)))
    } else {
      return(list(ok=FALSE, status=status, text=paste0("No parsable response. Raw: ", raw_text)))
    }
  } else {
    return(list(ok=FALSE, status=status, text=paste0("HTTP ", status, " - ", raw_text)))
  }
}

# Risk prediction functions (unchanged)
predictHypertension <- function(data) {
  risk_score <- 0
  if (data$ap_hi > 140) risk_score <- risk_score + 1
  if (data$ap_lo > 90) risk_score <- risk_score + 1
  if (data$age > 50) risk_score <- risk_score + 1
  if (data$weight > 80) risk_score <- risk_score + 1
  if (risk_score >= 2) {
    return("High")
  } else {
    return("Low")
  }
}

predictDiabetes <- function(data) {
  risk_score <- 0
  if (data$gluc > 2) risk_score <- risk_score + 1
  if (data$cholesterol > 2) risk_score <- risk_score + 1
  if (data$age > 45) risk_score <- risk_score + 1
  if (data$weight > 75) risk_score <- risk_score + 1
  if (risk_score >= 2) {
    return("High")
  } else {
    return("Low")
  }
}

# Generate Recommendations
generateRecommendations <- function(risk_profile, api_key) {
  prompt <- paste0("Provide personalized health recommendations to reduce cardiovascular risk for a patient with the following profile: ", risk_profile, ". Be detailed and helpful.")
  generateContent(prompt, api_key)
}

# Generate Storytelling based on risk level
generateStorytelling <- function(risk_level, top_factors, user_name, api_key) {
  prompt <- paste0(
    "Create a short, relatable health story for a person named ", user_name, " with ", risk_level, " cardiovascular risk.\n",
    "Include the top contributing risk factors: ", paste(top_factors, collapse=", "), ".\n",
    "Use friendly, motivational language, and include visual cues like progress bars or avatars to reflect the heart health status.\n",
    "Make it engaging and easy to understand for a general audience."
  )
  generateContent(prompt, api_key)
}

# SERVER
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Data & Model Processing
  data <- reactive({
    req(input$file)
    df <- read.csv(input$file$datapath, sep=";")
    df$age <- round(df$age/365)
    df$cardio <- as.factor(df$cardio)
    df
  })

  model_logreg <- reactiveVal()
  model_rf <- reactiveVal()
  model_xgb <- reactiveVal()

  logreg_summary <- reactiveVal()
  logreg_metrics <- reactiveVal()
  rf_summary <- reactiveVal()
  rf_metrics <- reactiveVal()
  xgb_summary <- reactiveVal()
  xgb_metrics <- reactiveVal()

  roc_data <- reactiveValues(logreg=NULL, rf=NULL, xgb=NULL)

  latest_risk <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  all_risks <- reactiveValues(hypertension=NULL, diabetes=NULL, cvd=NULL)

  # Train models
  observeEvent(input$file, {
    req(data())
    df <- data()
    set.seed(123)
    train_idx <- createDataPartition(df$cardio, p=0.8, list=FALSE)
    trainData <- df[train_idx,]
    testData <- df[-train_idx,]
    
    # Logistic Regression
    fit_lr <- glm(cardio ~ age+gender+height+weight+ap_hi+ap_lo+cholesterol+gluc+smoke+alco+active, data=trainData, family=binomial)
    model_logreg(fit_lr)
    logreg_summary(capture.output(summary(fit_lr)))
    probs_lr <- predict(fit_lr, newdata=testData, type="response")
    preds_lr <- ifelse(probs_lr>0.5,1,0)
    cm_lr <- confusionMatrix(factor(preds_lr), factor(testData$cardio))
    logreg_metrics(capture.output(cm_lr))
    roc_data$logreg <- roc(as.numeric(as.character(testData$cardio)), probs_lr)

    # Random Forest
    fit_rf <- randomForest(as.factor(cardio)~., data=trainData, importance=TRUE, ntree=100)
    model_rf(fit_rf)
    rf_summary(capture.output(print(fit_rf)))
    preds_rf <- predict(fit_rf, newdata=testData)
    cm_rf <- confusionMatrix(preds_rf, testData$cardio)
    rf_metrics(capture.output(cm_rf))
    probs_rf <- predict(fit_rf, newdata=testData, type="prob")[,2]
    roc_data$rf <- roc(as.numeric(as.character(testData$cardio)), probs_rf)

    # XGBoost
    train_matrix <- xgb.DMatrix(
      data=as.matrix(trainData[, c("age","gender","height","weight","ap_hi","ap_lo","cholesterol","gluc","smoke","alco","active")]),
      label=as.numeric(as.character(trainData$cardio))
    )
    test_matrix <- xgb.DMatrix(
      data=as.matrix(testData[, c("age","gender","height","weight","ap_hi","ap_lo","cholesterol","gluc","smoke","alco","active")]),
      label=as.numeric(as.character(testData$cardio))
    )
    params <- list(objective="binary:logistic", eval_metric="logloss", max_depth=3, eta=0.1)
    fit_xgb <- xgb.train(params=params, data=train_matrix, nrounds=50, verbose=0)
    model_xgb(fit_xgb)
    preds_xgb_prob <- predict(fit_xgb, test_matrix)
    preds_xgb <- ifelse(preds_xgb_prob>0.5,1,0)
    cm_xgb <- confusionMatrix(factor(preds_xgb), testData$cardio)
    xgb_summary(capture.output(print(fit_xgb)))
    xgb_metrics(capture.output(cm_xgb))
    roc_data$xgb <- roc(as.numeric(as.character(testData$cardio)), preds_xgb_prob)
  })

  # Data table
  output$dataTable <- renderDT({
    req(input$file)
    datatable(read.csv(input$file$datapath, sep=";"), options=list(pageLength=5))
  })

  # Prediction event
  observeEvent(input$predict, {
    req(model_logreg())
    new_data <- data.frame(
      age=input$age,
      gender=as.numeric(input$gender),
      height=input$height,
      weight=input$weight,
      ap_hi=input$ap_hi,
      ap_lo=input$ap_lo,
      cholesterol=as.numeric(input$cholesterol),
      gluc=as.numeric(input$gluc),
      smoke=as.numeric(input$smoke),
      alco=as.numeric(input$alco),
      active=as.numeric(input$active)
    )
    prob_lr <- predict(model_logreg(), new_data, type="response")
    risk_text <- if (prob_lr > 0.5) "🚩 High Risk of CVD" else "✅ Low Risk of CVD"
    latest_risk(paste0("Your CVD risk probability is ", round(prob_lr,3), ". Risk level: ", ifelse(prob_lr>0.5,"High","Low")))

    ht_result <- predictHypertension(new_data)
    all_risks$hypertension <- ht_result

    db_result <- predictDiabetes(new_data)
    all_risks$diabetes <- db_result

    output$prediction <- renderText({
      paste0("CVD Risk Probability: ", round(prob_lr,3), 
             "\nRisk: ", ifelse(prob_lr>0.5,"High","Low"),
             "\nHypertension Risk: ", ht_result,
             "\nDiabetes Risk: ", db_result)
    })

    risk_levels <- data.frame(
      Condition=c("CVD", "Hypertension", "Diabetes"),
      Risk=c(
        ifelse(prob_lr>0.5,1,0),
        ifelse(ht_result=="High",1,0),
        ifelse(db_result=="High",1,0)
      )
    )

    output$risk_comparison <- renderPlot({
      ggplot(risk_levels, aes(x=Condition, y=Risk, fill=as.factor(Risk))) +
        geom_bar(stat="identity") +
        scale_fill_manual(values=c("0"="#3498db","1"="#e74c3c"), labels=c("Low","High")) +
        ylim(0,1.2) +
        labs(title="Risk Level Comparison", y="Risk (0=Low, 1=High)", fill="Risk") +
        theme_minimal()
    })
  })

  # Model summaries and ROC plots
  output$logreg_summary <- renderText({ req(logreg_summary()); paste(logreg_summary(), collapse="\n") })
  output$logreg_metrics <- renderText({ req(logreg_metrics()); paste(logreg_metrics(), collapse="\n") })
  output$rf_summary <- renderText({ req(rf_summary()); paste(rf_summary(), collapse="\n") })
  output$rf_metrics <- renderText({ req(rf_metrics()); paste(rf_metrics(), collapse="\n") })
  output$xgb_summary <- renderText({ req(xgb_summary()); paste(xgb_summary(), collapse="\n") })
  output$xgb_metrics <- renderText({ req(xgb_metrics()); paste(xgb_metrics(), collapse="\n") })

  output$logreg_roc <- renderPlot({
    req(roc_data$logreg)
    plot(roc_data$logreg, col="blue", main="ROC Curve - Logistic Regression")
    legend("bottomright", legend=paste("AUC =", round(auc(roc_data$logreg),3)), col="blue", lwd=2)
  })
  output$rf_roc <- renderPlot({
    req(roc_data$rf)
    plot(roc_data$rf, col="green", main="ROC Curve - Random Forest")
    legend("bottomright", legend=paste("AUC =", round(auc(roc_data$rf),3)), col="green", lwd=2)
  })
  output$xgb_roc <- renderPlot({
    req(roc_data$xgb)
    plot(roc_data$xgb, col="red", main="ROC Curve - XGBoost")
    legend("bottomright", legend=paste("AUC =", round(auc(roc_data$xgb),3)), col="red", lwd=2)
  })

  # ----------- Chatbot with sentiment & emotional profile -----------

  chat_history <- reactiveVal(data.frame(role=character(), message=character(), sentiment_score=double(), sentiment_label=character(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
  chatbot_api_key <- reactiveVal(CHATBOT_API_KEY)
  speak_pref <- reactiveVal(FALSE)

  # Toggle speak option
  observeEvent(input$speak_option, {
    speak_pref(as.logical(input$speak_option))
  })

  # Send chat message
  observeEvent(input$send_chat, {
    req(input$chat_prompt)
    api_key <- chatbot_api_key()

    # Context info
    risk_info <- latest_risk()
    context_message <- ""
    if (!is.null(risk_info)) {
      context_message <- paste0("Here's your current health info: ", risk_info, "\n")
    }
    chat_hist <- chat_history()
    full_prompt <- paste0(
      context_message,
      "Conversation so far:\n",
      paste0(chat_hist$role, ": ", chat_hist$message, collapse="\n"),
      "\nYou: ", input$chat_prompt
    )

    # Sentiment analysis of user message
    user_sent <- sentiment(input$chat_prompt)
    user_score <- mean(user_sent$sentiment)
    user_score_clamped <- max(min(user_score, 1), -1)
    user_label <- if (user_score_clamped > 0.05) {
      "Positive"
    } else if (user_score_clamped < -0.05) {
      "Negative"
    } else {
      "Neutral"
    }
    new_user <- data.frame(role="user", message=input$chat_prompt, sentiment_score=user_score, sentiment_label=user_label, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    chat_history(rbind(chat_history(), new_user))
    # Generate bot reply
    bot_response <- generateContent(full_prompt, api_key)
    bot_text <- if (bot_response$ok) bot_response$text else paste0("[Error]: ", bot_response$text)
    # Sentiment for bot reply
    bot_sent <- sentiment(bot_text)
    bot_score <- mean(bot_sent$sentiment)
    bot_score_clamped <- max(min(bot_score, 1), -1)
    bot_label <- if (bot_score_clamped > 0.05) {
      "Positive"
    } else if (bot_score_clamped < -0.05) {
      "Negative"
    } else {
      "Neutral"
    }
    new_bot <- data.frame(role="assistant", message=bot_text, sentiment_score=bot_score, sentiment_label=bot_label, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    chat_history(rbind(chat_history(), new_bot))
    updateTextAreaInput(session, "chat_prompt", value="")

    # Speech synthesis
    if (isTRUE(speak_pref())) {
      session$sendCustomMessage(type='speakText', message=bot_text)
    }

    # Trigger recommendation if relevant
    if (grepl("recommend|advice|how to reduce risk", tolower(input$chat_prompt))) {
      rec_prompt <- "Based on the user's health data and risk profile, provide personalized health recommendations to reduce cardiovascular risk. Be detailed and helpful."
      rec_response <- generateContent(rec_prompt, api_key)
      rec_text <- if (rec_response$ok) rec_response$text else paste0("[Error]: ", rec_response$text)
      rec_df <- data.frame(role="assistant", message=rec_text, sentiment_score=NA, sentiment_label=NA, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
      chat_history(rbind(chat_history(), rec_df))
      if (isTRUE(speak_pref())) {
        session$sendCustomMessage(type='speakText', message=rec_text)
      }
    }
  })

  # Chat table output
  output$chat_table <- renderDT({
    df <- chat_history()
    if(nrow(df)==0) return(NULL)
    datatable(df, colnames=c("Role", "Message", "Sentiment Score", "Sentiment Label"), options=list(pageLength=20))
  })

  # Clear chat
  observeEvent(input$clear_chat, {
    chat_history(data.frame(role=character(), message=character(), sentiment_score=double(), sentiment_label=character(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
    latest_risk(NULL)
  })

  # Voice recognition JS
  session$onFlushed(function() {
    session$sendCustomMessage(type='initVoiceRecognition', message=list())
  })
  observe({
    session$sendCustomMessage(type='voiceRecognition', message=list())
  })

  # Voice recognition result
  observeEvent(input$voice_text, {
    new_user <- data.frame(role="user", message=input$voice_text, sentiment_score=NA, sentiment_label=NA, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    chat_history(rbind(chat_history(), new_user))
    updateTextAreaInput(session, "chat_prompt", value=input$voice_text)
  })

  # Voice buttons
  observeEvent(input$start_voice, {
    session$sendCustomMessage(type='startVoice', message=list())
  })
  observeEvent(input$stop_voice, {
    session$sendCustomMessage(type='stopVoice', message=list())
  })

  # ----------- Sentiment & Emotional Profile of Recommendations -----------

  # Reactive value to store NRC scores
  rv_emotional_profile <- reactiveVal(NULL)

  # When user clicks "Get Recommendations"
  observeEvent(input$get_recommendations, {
    req(latest_risk())
    # Generate recommendation text
    rec_response <- generateRecommendations(latest_risk(), CHATBOT_API_KEY)
    rec_text <- if (rec_response$ok) rec_response$text else paste0("[Error]: ", rec_response$text)
    rv_recommendations$text <- rec_text
    output$recommendation_text <- renderText({ rec_text })

    # Generate emotional paragraph
    analysis_prompt <- paste0(
      "Analyze the following health recommendation in terms of emotional tone, positivity, motivation, and discouragement, and provide a paragraph summary and should not be in one line. Have bullet points please.:\n\n",
      rec_text
    )
    emotional_analysis <- generateContent(analysis_prompt, CHATBOT_API_KEY)

    # Compute NRC scores if possible
    if (emotional_analysis$ok) {
      nrc_scores <- get_nrc_sentiment(rec_text)
      # Sum scores for each emotion
      nrc_vector <- sapply(c("joy","sadness","anger","fear","trust","disgust","surprise","anticipation"), function(emotion) {
        sum(nrc_scores[[emotion]])
      })
      # Store in reactive value
      rv_emotional_profile(list(
        paragraph=emotional_analysis$text,
        scores=nrc_vector
      ))
    } else {
      rv_emotional_profile(NULL)
    }

    # Render in the output
    output$recommendation_tone <- renderText({
      profile <- rv_emotional_profile()
      if (is.null(profile)) {
        return(paste0("Error in analyzing emotional profile."))
      }
      # Format scores
      scores_text <- paste0(
        "Emotional Intensity:\n",
        paste0(
          toupper(names(profile$scores)),
          ": ",
          round(profile$scores, 2),
          collapse="\n"
        )
      )
      paste0(profile$paragraph, "\n\n", scores_text)
    })

    # Switch to the Sentiment & Tone tab
    updateTabsetPanel(session, "main_tabs", selected = "Sentiment & Tone Analysis")
  })

  # Generate questions for Post-Recommendation
  questions <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  observeEvent(input$main_tabs, {
    if (input$main_tabs == "Post-Recommendation Questionnaire") {
      prompt_q <- "Generate 4 open-ended questions for a patient to assess if they understood and will implement health recommendations about reducing cardiovascular risk."
      res <- generateContent(prompt_q, CHATBOT_API_KEY)
      if (res$ok) {
        q_text <- res$text
        q_list <- unlist(strsplit(q_text, "\n+"))
        q_list <- trimws(q_list)
        q_list <- q_list[q_list != ""]
        questions(q_list)
      } else {
        questions(c(
          "Did you understand the recommendations provided?",
          "Do you plan to implement these recommendations?",
          "What challenges do you anticipate in following these suggestions?",
          "Any additional comments or questions?"
        ))
      }
    }
  })

  output$question_ui <- renderUI({
    req(questions())
    qlist <- questions()
    lapply(seq_along(qlist), function(i) {
      div(
        class="question",
        tags$label(qlist[i]),
        textAreaInput(
          inputId = paste0("question_", i),
          label = NULL,
          value = "",
          rows=3,
          width="100%"
        )
      )
    })
  })

  # Submit answers
  observeEvent(input$submit_answers, {
    req(questions())
    answers <- sapply(seq_along(questions()), function(i) {
      input[[paste0("question_", i)]]
    })
    # Could store answers here
    output$thank_you_msg <- renderText({
      paste("Thank you for your feedback! Your responses have been recorded.")
    })
  })

  # Download recommendations as PDF
  rv_recommendations <- reactiveValues(text = NULL)
  observeEvent(input$get_recommendations, {
    req(latest_risk())
    rec_response <- generateRecommendations(latest_risk(), CHATBOT_API_KEY)
    rec_text <- if (rec_response$ok) rec_response$text else paste0("[Error]: ", rec_response$text)
    rv_recommendations$text <- rec_text
  })

  output$download_recommendations <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {
      paste0("Health_Recommendations_", Sys.Date(), ".pdf")
    },
    content = function(file) {
      req(rv_recommendations$text)
      tempRmd <- tempfile(fileext = ".Rmd")
      writeLines(
        c(
          "---",
          "title: \"Health Recommendations\"",
          "output: pdf_document",
          "---",
          "",
          "## Personalized Health Recommendations",
          "",
          rv_recommendations$text
        ),
        con = tempRmd
      )
      rmarkdown::render(tempRmd, output_file = file, quiet=TRUE)
    }
  )

  # ----------- New: Emotion Analysis Explanation -----------

  # Reactive value to store emotion scores for display
  emotion_scores <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  emotion_explanation <- reactiveVal(NULL)

  observeEvent(input$generate_emotion_explanation, {
    req(rv_emotional_profile())
    profile <- rv_emotional_profile()
    # Prepare prompt for generateContent
    prompt_explain <- paste0(
      "Based on the following emotion scores:\n",
      paste0(
        toupper(names(profile$scores)),
        ": ",
        round(profile$scores, 2),
        collapse="\n"
      ),
      "\n\nExplain in detail why these emotions have these specific scores, providing possible reasons and reasoning for each emotion based on the context of the health recommendations and the sentiment analysis."
    )
    # Generate detailed explanation
    explanation_result <- generateContent(prompt_explain, CHATBOT_API_KEY)
    if (explanation_result$ok) {
      emotion_explanation(explanation_result$text)
    } else {
      emotion_explanation(paste0("[Error generating explanation]: ", explanation_result$text))
    }
    # Display scores
    score_text <- paste0(
      "Emotion Scores:\n",
      paste0(
        toupper(names(profile$scores)),
        ": ",
        round(profile$scores, 2),
        collapse="\n"
      )
    )
    emotion_scores(score_text)
    # Display explanation
    output$emotion_scores <- renderText({ emotion_scores() })
    output$emotion_explanation <- renderText({ emotion_explanation() })
  })

  # ----------- Generate Storytelling based on risk prediction -----------

  # Reactive to store the narrative
  rv_story <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  rv_story_visual <- reactiveVal(NULL)

  observeEvent(input$generate_story, {
    req(latest_risk())
    # Determine risk category based on probability thresholds
    # Recompute probability for CVD risk
    req(model_logreg())
    new_data <- data.frame(
      age=input$age,
      gender=as.numeric(input$gender),
      height=input$height,
      weight=input$weight,
      ap_hi=input$ap_hi,
      ap_lo=input$ap_lo,
      cholesterol=as.numeric(input$cholesterol),
      gluc=as.numeric(input$gluc),
      smoke=as.numeric(input$smoke),
      alco=as.numeric(input$alco),
      active=as.numeric(input$active)
    )
    prob_lr <- predict(model_logreg(), new_data, type="response")
    risk_level <- if (prob_lr > 0.7) {
      "High"
    } else if (prob_lr > 0.4) {
      "Moderate"
    } else {
      "Low"
    }
    user_name <- input$name
    # For top contributing factors, for simplicity, list some factors
    top_factors <- c()
    if (new_data$ap_hi > 140) top_factors <- c(top_factors, "High systolic blood pressure")
    if (new_data$ap_lo > 90) top_factors <- c(top_factors, "High diastolic blood pressure")
    if (new_data$age > 50) top_factors <- c(top_factors, "Older age")
    if (new_data$weight > 80) top_factors <- c(top_factors, "Overweight")
    if (length(top_factors)==0) top_factors <- c("Several risk factors")
    
    # Generate storytelling with user name
    story_res <- generateStorytelling(risk_level, top_factors, user_name, CHATBOT_API_KEY)
    rv_story(story_res$text)
    # Optional: Visual cues like progress bar
    output$story_text <- renderText({ rv_story() })
    output$story_visual <- renderUI({
      risk_color <- switch(risk_level,
                           "Low"="#27ae60",
                           "Moderate"="#f39c12",
                           "High"="#c0392b")
      tags$div(
        style="text-align:center;",
        tags$div(
          style=paste0("width:150px; height:150px; margin:auto; border-radius:50%; background-color:", risk_color, "; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:1.2em; color:#fff; font-weight:bold;"),
          paste(risk_level, "Risk")
        ),
        # Progress bar
        tags$div(
          style="width:80%; height:20px; background-color:#ddd; border-radius:10px; margin:auto; margin-top:15px;",
          tags$div(
            style=paste0("width:", switch(risk_level, "Low"=33, "Moderate"=66, "High"=100), "%; height:100%; background-color:", risk_color, "; border-radius:10px;"),
            ""
          )
        )
      )
    })
  })

  # ----------- New: Sentiment for Storytelling Tab Logic -----------

  # For the 'Sentiment for Storytelling' tab, define reactive values
  storytelling_content <- reactiveVal("")
  story_tone_analysis <- reactiveVal("")
  story_reliability <- reactiveVal("")

  # Button to analyze storytelling tone
  observeEvent(input$analyze_story_tone, {
    req(rv_story())
    story_text <- rv_story()
    storytelling_content(story_text)
    # Generate sentiment and reliability analysis
    prompt_tone <- paste0(
      "Analyze the tone of the following story. Indicate if it is positive, neutral, or negative. Also, assess if the story is reliable based on the emotional content and coherence.\n\n\"",
      story_text,
      "\"\n\nProvide a brief analysis including tone and reliability assessment."
    )
    analysis_result <- generateContent(prompt_tone, CHATBOT_API_KEY)
    # Save and display
    if (analysis_result$ok) {
      story_tone_analysis(analysis_result$text)
    } else {
      story_tone_analysis(paste0("[Error]: ", analysis_result$text))
    }
    # For simplicity, assume the reliability is part of the analysis text
    if (analysis_result$ok) {
      story_reliability(analysis_result$text)
    } else {
      story_reliability(paste0("[Error]: ", analysis_result$text))
    }
    # Render outputs
    output$story_content <- renderText({ story_text })
    output$story_tone_analysis <- renderText({ story_tone_analysis() })
    output$story_reliability <- renderText({ story_reliability() })
  })

  # ----------- End of server logic -----------

}

# JS for voice recognition & synthesis
js_code <- '
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("initVoiceRecognition", function(message) {
  window.recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
  recognition.continuous = false;
  recognition.interimResults = false;
  recognition.lang = "en-US";

  recognition.onresult = function(event) {
    var transcript = event.results[0][0].transcript;
    Shiny.setInputValue("voice_text", transcript);
  };
  recognition.onerror = function(event) {
    console.error(event.error);
  };
});
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("startVoice", function(message) {
  if (window.recognition) {
    recognition.start();
  }
});
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("stopVoice", function(message) {
  if (window.recognition) {
    recognition.stop();
  }
});
// Speech synthesis
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("speakText", function(message) {
  if ("speechSynthesis" in window) {
    var utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(message);
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
  }
});
'

# Run app
shinyApp(
  ui = tagList(
    tags$script(HTML(js_code)),
    ui
  ),
  server = server
)
